body.prompt: Close-up at the same low wooden folding table under the same warm pendant lamp in the same night kitchen: the same Korean mother from the reference image (same face, same short curly permed black hair, same pastel floral apron over a lilac cardigan), reading glasses now on her nose, slowly writing on a small square of cream notepaper with a blue ballpoint pen; the handwriting is only soft blurred squiggles, not readable. Next to her hand: a pair of freshly hand-knitted thick red wool socks, a ball of red yarn with two wooden knitting needles. The same open brown cardboard box full of wrapped kimchi jars and side-dish containers sits just behind her, softly out of focus. Her eyes are glistening with tears, a small loving smile. The magpie stands beside the red socks, peeking at the note with its head tilted. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
